label: early original phase (steps 2-3) after two inputs from {t,v,x,y,c,3,e,q}
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase at positions 2-5 (t=2,3 hold ~89% of mass, t=4 ~11%, never at t<=1, the delimiter, or the copy phase). Within that window it depends on which tokens came first: it is driven by early inputs from a preferred set {t,v,x,y,c,3,e,q} (first_tok/prev_tok/prev2_tok lift 2.5-4.8x), and the current input x,c,3,q,l adds to it. The strongest activations (e.g. t v [x] [x], v y [x] [x]) have the first two tokens and the current token all in the set. It looks like a graded weighted sum over the first few tokens, so the boolean predicate (t in 2..3 and at least two preferred tokens already seen) gets most of the mass (dev mass recall 0.76) but has low precision (~0.34): many sequences with preferred openings do not cross threshold, and some weaker activations come from other tokens (o, l, a, g).
